audit.description: 🔬 Full project audit (12-expert panel with conditional activation)
audit.prompt: Analyze this project with the DOMYH audit panel (12 experts: Security, Architecture, Performance, Quality, DevOps, Product + 6 conditional). Provide findings with file:line references and severity ratings.

code.prompt: Write production-ready code following DOMYH standards: explicit types, proper error handling, Clean Architecture, and tests. Follow language-specific best practices.

debug.prompt: Debug this issue using root cause analysis: reproduce → isolate → analyze → fix → verify. Provide evidence with file:line references.

test.prompt: Write comprehensive tests following TDD principles. Cover edge cases, error paths, and integration scenarios.

review.prompt: Review this code for logic errors, security issues, performance problems, and adherence to DOMYH quality standards.

refactor.prompt: Refactor this code: identify code smells, apply appropriate design patterns, improve readability while preserving behavior.

doc.prompt: Generate comprehensive documentation for this code: JSDoc/GoDoc comments, README sections, API docs as appropriate.

security.prompt: Scan this code for security vulnerabilities: OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25, injection risks, auth issues, data exposure.
